newsitem.title: UK: Chelsfield pockets 25mln stg in London deals.
newsitem.headline: Chelsfield pockets 25mln stg in London deals.

text.p: UK property company Chelsfield said on Wednesday it has received 25.5 million stg from the sale of property in London to Frogmore Estates and from a settlement over access rights with the Metropole hotel, which was sold by Lonrho to Stakis last week.
Chelsfield has sold to Frogmore two acres of more than 10 it owns at the eastern end of the Paddington Basin in west London.
The company also agreed immediately prior to the sale to Stakis by Lonrho, revised access arrangements with the adjoining Metropole hotel.
Some of the proceeds from the two deals will go towards financing redevelopment of the area.

"Whilst we remain generally cautious regarding new construction, we believe that current market conditions are such as to enable a limited number of large development schemes to be progressed successfully," said Elliott Bernerd of Chelsfield.
"Paddington Basin represents one such large scale urban redevelopment opportunity."
